items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: He had Una Mae Carlisle with him, the singer.

ctx.x: 52nd Street again at the Three Dueces. That's one of the clubs I have listed.

Yeah, I think I went in there with Fats Waller for a spell, for about a two-week or a four-week engagement. Yeah, I remember that. I think Fats had just come back from Europe or something like that. He had Una Mae Carlisle with him, the singer.
